Property Description

This charming stone house is located in the heart of the historic centre of Fossalto, in the Molise region, surrounded by green countryside and wooded valleys. The regional capital, Campobasso, is just 22 km away.

The property has approximately 114 sqm of cadastral area and is arranged over three floors. The property also includes approximately 4,700 sqm of sloping land, located just a few metres behind the house.
